attributes.board_name: South Dakota State Board of Dentistry

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE; 50 of the 100 hours must be academic: at a CODA-accredited dental school, by a presenter affiliated with one, or from an ADA CERP or AGD PACE approved provider
rules.notes: Five-year CE cycle; license renewed annually by July 1 ($200 + $20 CE fee per year). Current AHA Healthcare Provider/Red Cross CPR card required. Limits per cycle: home study 30 h, practice management 10 h, nutrition 15 h, CPR 15 h. Sedation/GA/host permit: +25 h anesthesia CE.

topics.who: Current AHA Healthcare Provider/Red Cross CPR card; max 15 CPR h per cycle
